short_summary: Discover essential tips and upcoming multiplayer updates for the challenging racing game Star Wars: Galactic Racer.

sources.name: Polygon
sources.title: 10 Star Wars Galactic Racer tips to help you beat Kestar Bool

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer Multiplayer Party Limit Will Be Doubled Via Update

paragraphs: Star Wars: Galactic Racer has quickly established itself as a brutally difficult yet exhilarating title developed by Fuse Games, featuring blistering speeds that leave little room for error. Players aiming to cross the finish line and ultimately defeat Kestar Bool must master various mechanics, starting with vehicle selection. At the beginning of each campaign, drivers can choose a landspeeder, a speeder bike, or a skim speeder. While the landspeeder offers a balanced and approachable ride, the speeder bike boasts exceptional agility with drift-boosts, and the skim speeder holds the highest skill ceiling due to its specialized Knife Edge ability for tight corners.

Nailing a perfect start in the game can be tricky, requiring players to keep the throttle inside the middle section of the meter just after the third light. However, unlike other racing games, achieving a perfect start only grants a minor boost unless paired with specific upgrades. Instead, focusing on build strategy is vital. Experienced players suggest investing in the ramjet and adopting the Redliner racer style, which allows users to push their engines to dangerous limits for maximum power. Parts like Heated Fuel and Redlining Power further enhance this. Alternatively, the Tenacious style provides an Autopilot feature and an extra crash allowance, making it an invaluable tool for tackling grueling, twisting tracks where you might otherwise crash.

Navigating the tour map carefully is equally important to avoid perilous situations like eliminator races, which pose a severe risk of losing league tokens and forcing a complete restart. Engaging in sidebets offers a reliable method to earn extra credits safely by backing competitors predicted to finish in the middle of the pack. Additionally, players are advised to disable takedown cutaway cameras in the accessibility settings menu to prevent losing control of their vehicles during cinematic sequences at breakneck speeds. These cutaways, while visually sublime, can cause players to plow into walls immediately after regaining control.

Beyond single-player campaigns, the game has captured critical acclaim for reviving a dormant segment of the sci-fi universe. Responding directly to community feedback, developer Fuse Games recently announced via social media that an upcoming update will soon double the multiplayer party size from three to six players. This change aims to address player concerns within the first few weeks of launch, ensuring an even more engaging experience for friends racing online. Whether you are mastering the ramjet or planning your route through the galactic gauntlet, success requires both tactical planning and lightning-fast reflexes.

facts.fact: Star Wars: Galactic Racer is a challenging game developed by Fuse Games, featuring high speeds and campaign gameplay to defeat Kestar Bool.
Players can choose between three vehicle types at the start of a campaign: landspeeder, speeder bike, and skim speeder.
Fuse Games announced an upcoming update to increase multiplayer party sizes from three to six players following fan feedback.
